card.name: Words about expense and heavy resource use
card.fires_on: Words that say something costs a lot or uses large amounts, such as "expensive", "cost a lot", "massive amounts" and "tens of thousands". It fires in general web text about money, spending or resource demands.

modes.label: Expensive
modes.description: The word "expensive" describing a project, war, research or item.
modes.example: The Afghanistan War was proving to be both<< expensive>> and unsuccessful.

modes.label: Large amounts needed
modes.description: Words of quantity or demand that signal a heavy consumption of resources.
modes.example: Companies can also save money recycling the massive<< amounts>> of water it takes to frack a well

modes.description: Words such as cost, lot or thousands in statements about price.
